svg.title: Global steel: source-defined emissions | absolute levels

cc:Work.dc:title: Global steel: source-defined emissions | absolute levels
cc:Work.dc:description: Global steel source-defined emissions: OMNIA reported GHG versus OPEN-PROM energy-related CO2, shown in absolute source quantities with dashed matching reference trajectories. Rows show medium then high settings; columns show NDC then NDC+LTT. OPEN-PROM's corresponding NDC/NDC+LTT CSV supplies its reference; OMNIA uses the same climate's no-CE scenario. The two OMNIA curves change CE adoption area (EU or EU plus partners); every plotted quantity is global. OPEN-PROM medium/high scenario labels do not establish equivalent interventions or geographic coverage. OPEN-PROM uses the supplied World aggregate once; OMNIA sums its 28 model regions once. OPEN-PROM annual observations and OMNIA source years are retained from 2019 through 2050, without interpolation onto a common grid, smoothing, extrapolation or historical recalibration. OMNIA selects Emissions|GHG|Industry|Iron and Steel in MtCO2e/yr. OPEN-PROM selects Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Industry|Iron and Steel in Mt CO2/yr. The latter equals its gross series minus reported capture within rounding; capture is not subtracted again. OPEN-PROM supplies no steel-specific process-emissions or GHG total. The two source quantities have different gas and accounting scopes; neither absolute levels nor percentage responses establish harmonised steel-emissions comparisons. OMNIA missing additive activity follows the configured provisional zero treatment; OPEN-PROM requires complete reported World totals. Raw quantities, units, references, source scenarios and conversion factors accompany the figure data.
